title: SkillRecord
description: A normalized record for an AI coding skill — a markdown document or live endpoint injected into LLM context to enable ecosystem-specific workflows.

skill_type.description: reference=static knowledge (error catalog, addresses). workflow=sequential execution pattern. integration=protocol-specific context. security=audit/review. orchestration=multi-agent coordination. collection=a set of sub-skills.

fetch_pattern.description: How the skill is retrieved. Determines staleness model: url-static and github-repo can become stale; mcp-server is always current.

fetch_url.description: Primary URL to fetch the skill. For github-repo, this is the repo root. For url-static, this is the direct markdown URL.

commit_hash.description: Git commit hash if the skill is pinned to a specific revision. Null = floating. Pinned = reproducible but won't receive upstream fixes.

install_commands.description: How to install this skill in each supported environment.

purpose.description: What this skill does when injected. One sentence. Written for retrieval — should match the queries that would benefit from this skill.

tools_contextualized.description: IDs of ToolRecords this skill provides context for. Used for reverse lookup: given a tool, find skills that teach it.

workflow_refs.description: IDs of WorkflowRecords where this skill should be injected.

environments_validated.description: Environments where this skill has been confirmed to work correctly. Multi-env validation is a strong trust signal.

staleness_risk.description: How quickly this skill's content is likely to go stale. Reference skills for stable APIs = low. Gas price skills = critical.

staleness_reason.description: Why the staleness_risk is rated as it is. Required when risk is high or critical.

sub_skills.description: For collection-type skills — the individual skills in the set.
